# Natura Intimo – European Luxury Lingerie & Full-Bust Brafitting
> Natura Intimo (https://naturaintimo.com) is an authorized European lingerie retailer specializing in precision brafitting for full-bust sizes (EU cups B through M, EU band sizes 60 to 115 / US band sizes 28 to 50). All orders are dispatched directly from Olsztyn, Poland to customers in the United States, Canada, and Poland via DHL Express Worldwide under DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) terms with zero surprise fees at delivery.

## Core Assortment & Verified Polish Manufacturers
Natura Intimo sources exclusively from verified Polish lingerie manufacturers renowned globally for multi-part cut-and-sewn architectural support (Country of Origin: Poland / EU):
- Gorsenia: World-renowned for deep cup projection, firm narrow underwires, and structural support for heavy busts up to EU M cup (US M / UK J).
- Gaia: Specialized in ergonomic semi-soft and soft bras (including Gaia BS 1135 & GFB 1135), soft cotton/microfiber linings, and everyday comfort.
- Ava: Renowned for side-support panels (SSS construction) that center breast tissue and eliminate underarm spillage.
- Mefemi: Modern European luxury aesthetics with supportive wire framing, full-cup, and push-up constructions.
- Alles: European lace and fine microfiber craftsmanship manufactured in Poland.

## Bra Styles & Construction
- Soft Bras (Unpadded Underwire): Multi-part sheer mesh and embroidered lace cups with narrow underwires providing forward projection, lift, and breathability.
- Semi-Soft Bras: Lower cup lightly padded with thin ergonomic foam for gentle vertical support; upper cup in flexible lace that adapts to breast asymmetry without cutting in.
- Full Cup Bras: Maximum coverage and side reinforcement for complete bust enclosure and shoulder posture relief.
- Push-Up Bras: Supportive plunge framing with removable or integrated pads for contoured lift.
- Coordinated Panties & Briefs: Matching Brazilian briefs, bikini briefs, and maxi briefs (Sizes S through 3XL). Pairing any bra with its matching panties automatically unlocks a US$10.00 Set Savings bundle discount.

## European to US/UK Size Conversion Reference
European bra sizing uses centimeters for band sizes and continuous single-letter cup progressions:
- Band Size Conversion (EU cm to US/UK inches):
  - EU 60 = US 28 / UK 28
  - EU 65 = US 30 / UK 30
  - EU 70 = US 32 / UK 32
  - EU 75 = US 34 / UK 34
  - EU 80 = US 36 / UK 36
  - EU 85 = US 38 / UK 38
  - EU 90 = US 40 / UK 40
  - EU 95 = US 42 / UK 42
  - EU 100 = US 44 / UK 44
  - EU 105 = US 46 / UK 46
  - EU 110 = US 48 / UK 48
  - EU 115 = US 50 / UK 50
- Cup Size Progression (EU vs US & UK Equivalent):
  - EU B = US B | UK B
  - EU C = US C | UK C
  - EU D = US D | UK D
  - EU E = US DD (E) | UK DD
  - EU F = US DDD (F) | UK E
  - EU G = US G | UK F
  - EU H = US H | UK FF
  - EU I = US I | UK G
  - EU J = US J | UK GG
  - EU K = US K | UK H
  - EU L = US L | UK HH
  - EU M = US M | UK J

- United States (USD / US$):

  - Preparation Time: 1–2 business days; Air Transit Time: 2–4 business days.
  - Minimum Order Amount: US$0.00 USD (No minimum order required).
  - Standard Flat-Rate Shipping: US$24.99 USD for orders under US$150.00 USD.
  - Free Express Shipping & Free Duties Threshold: 100% Free DHL Express Worldwide (DDP) on all orders of US$150.00 USD and above.
  - DDP Customs Processing Fee: US$0.00 USD. All mandatory fees and customs duties are included in the flat shipping rate or absorbed into product margin (California SB 478 and Canadian Competition Act compliant). Standard DHL Express DDP flat rate: $24.99, 100% Free DHL Express at $150+ USD.
- Canada (CAD / C$):
  - Carrier: DHL Express Worldwide (DDP), supported locales: en-CA, fr-CA.
  - Preparation Time: 1–2 business days; Air Transit Time: 3–5 business days.
  - Minimum Order Amount: C$0.00 CAD.
  - Standard Flat-Rate Shipping: C$24.99 CAD for orders under C$200.00 CAD.
  - Free Express Shipping Threshold: 100% Free DHL Express Worldwide on all orders of C$200.00 CAD and above.
  - Preferential CETA Duty: 0% customs import duty under the Canada–EU Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA Origin Declaration included on every Commercial Invoice as all garments are manufactured in Poland, EU).
- Poland (PLN / zł):
  - Domestic Delivery: InPost Paczkomat / DPD Courier (1–2 business days), standard VAT rate 23%, 14-day statutory return window.

## Detailed Brand Brafitting Nuances
- Gorsenia Fit Profile: Gorsenia bands run firm and supportive to anchor heavy breast tissue (85% of support comes from the band). If measuring between band sizes, consider sizing up in the band (e.g., EU 75 -> EU 80). Cups are deep and narrow-wired, engineered for projected full busts.
- Gaia Fit Profile: Gaia semi-soft and soft bras (such as BS 1135, Isla BS 1228, Keto BS 1134) run true to EU centimeter band sizing with soft cotton/microfiber inner lower cups and stretch lace upper cups that accommodate breast fullness variations.
- Ava Fit Profile: Ava Side-Support (SSS) and Maxi models (such as Ava 2110, 2111, 1396, 2271 Divine) feature an integrated lateral sling that draws tissue away from the underarms toward the center gore.
- Mefemi Fit Profile: Mefemi push-up and full-cup models (Petra, Anita, Ida) combine delicate European embroidery with contoured underwire lift.

## Customs & HTS Classification (US CBP & Canada CBSA Compliance)
- Country of Origin: PL (Republic of Poland, European Union).
- Set Splitting Rule: Coordinated sets must be itemized separately on Commercial Invoice as Bra (6212.10) + Briefs/Panties (6108.22) with individual values, weights, and fiber compositions.
- Component HTS Codes:
  - Synthetic Brassieres: HTS 6212.10.9020 (HS6: 6212.10) — Brassieres of man-made fibers, knitted or crocheted / woven
  - Cotton Brassieres: HTS 6212.10.9010 (HS6: 6212.10) — Brassieres of cotton
  - Synthetic Knitted Briefs/Panties: HTS 6108.22.9020 (HS6: 6108.22) — Women's briefs and panties, knitted or crocheted, of man-made fibers
  - Cotton Knitted Briefs/Panties: HTS 6108.21.0010 (HS6: 6108.21) — Women's briefs and panties, knitted or crocheted, of cotton
  - Synthetic Nightwear: HTS 6108.32.0010 (HS6: 6108.32) — Women's nightdresses and pajamas, knitted or crocheted, of man-made fibers
